limits: Themes cannot independently recolor native tab underlines or toolbar glyphs.

Theme packages cannot alter native pane geometry.

Native active right tool icons and markers use foreground rather than theme ring.
Native current worktree uses foreground-based gray wash.
Tinted left-sidebar mode at zero opacity overrides theme accent and ring with neutral foreground blends.
Selected worktree titles were dimmed to 80% foreground.
